description.value:
You touch a creature that has died within the last hour and call it back to life, provided its spirit is willing and able to return; the target awakens with its hit points fully restored. This power does not function on droids or constructs.

The return also purges any poison or disease afflicting the creature at the moment of death, seals all fatal wounds, and regrows any lost body parts.

Returning from death is a harrowing ordeal: the creature suffers a -4 penalty to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. Each long rest it completes reduces this penalty by 1 until it fades entirely.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 7
